label: Contextual truth-restricted step2 and…: The contextual reading carries if-p from step1 to step2…
term: contextual truth-restricted step2 and common-knower antecedent
definition: The contextual reading carries if-p from step1 to step2, so each truth has some actual knower; step3 then adds one common knower of all truths.
note: Truth restriction is an interpretation choice, not silent textual correction. Varying per-truth knowers do not provide one common witness without an additional bridge.
